coauthors.name: Tanya Roosta
coauthors.affiliation: UC Berkeley; Amazon, Saratoga, CA, USA
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-author of arXiv 2406.14805 'How Well Do LLMs Represent Values Across Cultures? Empirical Analysis of LLM Responses Based on Hofstede Cultural Dimensions' (KDD 2025), which states: 'We prompt different LLMs with a series of advice requests based on 5 Hofstede Cultural Dimensions -- a quantifiable way of representing the values of a country... we incorporate personas representing 36 different countries' and presents 'recommendations for training value-aligned and culturally sensitive LLMs.' Directly cultural values in LLMs.

coauthors.name: Aman Chadha
coauthors.affiliation: Stanford University; Amazon GenAI, Palo Alto, CA, USA
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-author of arXiv 2406.14805 on Hofstede cultural dimensions in LLMs: 'It is critical to understand whether LLMs showcase different values to the user based on the stereotypical values of a user's known country'; the paper ends with recommendations for 'training value-aligned and culturally sensitive LLMs' and mitigating 'culture and language alignment issues with LLMs.'

coauthors.name: Chirag Shah
coauthors.affiliation: University of Washington, Seattle, WA, USA (Information School / Paul G. Allen School)
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Senior author of arXiv 2406.14805, the Hofstede-dimensions study of LLM cultural values across 36 national personas: 'the methodology and the framework developed here can help further understand and mitigate culture and language alignment issues with LLMs.' Cultural value representation and alignment in LLMs.

coauthors.name: Alex Mallen
coauthors.affiliation: EleutherAI (per arXiv 2312.01037 'Eliciting Latent Knowledge from Quirky Language Models')
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Only shared work is arXiv 2312.01037 on eliciting latent knowledge / truthfulness probing ('find patterns in a capable neural network's activations that robustly track the true state of the world'). An arXiv author search over his titles returned no work matching culture, cultural/moral values, cross-cultural, persona or Hofstede. Interpretability and truthfulness, no cultural dimension.

coauthors.name: Madeline Brumley
coauthors.affiliation: co-author on arXiv 2312.01037 (EleutherAI / University of Washington collaboration)
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Only shared work is the ELK 'quirky language models' paper on probing for latent knowledge and detecting untruthful behavior. arXiv author search returned no titles touching culture, cultural or moral values, or value alignment. Fails the cultural-values gate.

coauthors.name: Nora Belrose
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Works on interpretability, probing and concept erasure; only shared work is arXiv 2312.01037 (ELK from quirky LMs). arXiv author search across her papers returned no titles matching culture, cultural/moral values, cross-cultural or Hofstede. Generic alignment/interpretability without a cultural-values angle.
